description: Add a technician note to an existing service request in ManageEngine ServiceDesk Plus. Open the request titled 'Email account not working - cannot send or receive emails', add the following note: 'Investigated the issue. Found that the mail server configuration was changed during last week update. Reverting settings now.'. The note should be internal (not visible to requester). Log in with username: administrator, password: administrator.
